     Importance: Normal
  Inline-Images: image001.jpg



Good morning Title Team!
Pls see below for a new request for a rush cash purch for $1,075,000. Buyer wants us to handle:
     1. Title exam
     2. Title due diligence with a close look at easements/covenants
     3. Opinion on whether others can enter the property for hunting? Can others shoot onto the property from another
        property? Can the buyer hunt on the property?
     4. They also want to know if anyone is planning on building anything crazy (they cited nuclear power plant) in the
        vicinity. I explained that we could not do a title search or research on every surrounding property but that we could
        look at the Town of Bradford planning board meeting minutes for past 6 months to see if anything has applied to
        do anything in the vicinity that could potentially impact their peaceful enjoyment of the property
She initially said she wanted to close dec 2 and I politely reminded her that that is really only 3 business days away but she
begged me to work toward that week as a goal. The P&S close date is somewhere around Dec 13/14 but I don't have it
yet.
I'm preparing the engagement letter myself but I'd like feedback on what you think our flat rate should be for this extra
work. $1500?
Property is under agreement, inspections are clear, and all deposits are in so pls move forward with title asap.
Regards,

Dear Steve,
Thank you for your email. I had the pleasure of connecting with Jen this morning and she provided me with many of the
details for your transaction including your desire to learn more about the title and whether there are any easements. We
will also provide you with an opinion regarding hunting on the property and will let you know if there is any indication in
the Town of Bradford planning board meeting minutes of construction in the vicinity that could impede your peaceful
enjoyment of the property.
I'll reach out to             this morning to request the Purchase and Sale Agreement. I'll prepare an engagement letter
outlining our services within the hour. In the meantime, we will commence our title examination and planning for closing.
If you have any questions or would like to speak with me, I may be reached at
